title: Prefix index for search suggestions
insight: LeetCode 208 Implement Trie: one node per character with a terminal flag and a pass-through count, so every query walks only the argument
prompt: This module is the suggestion index behind the search box. Implement the Index type in index.go so it matches README.md: Add, Contains, HasPrefix and CountPrefix with the performance the README asks for. Keep the exported API and package name as they are, standard library only, and check that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` are clean. Feel free to add your own tests.
